insights.title: Cold Brew was missing for 5 days
insights.recommendation: Find out what stopped Cold Brew from selling (2026-09-05 to 2026-09-09) and set up a backup so regulars can still get it next time. Total sales held up: about normal (4% above the usual level).
insights.summary: Cold Brew sold 0 instead of about 74 over 5 days (2026-09-05 to 2026-09-09), about $333.00 less Cold Brew revenue. But total sales were about normal ($2,730.85 vs about $2,617.84 expected): customers ordered other items instead (a little more of everything else), so this was not money the cafe lost.

insights.title: Fewest orders arrive during 2pm–4pm
insights.recommendation: Schedule prep, cleaning and breaks during 2pm–4pm (6.7 orders a day), and have the most staff on at 8am–10am (23.8 orders a day).
insights.summary: Over the last 4 weeks, 2pm–4pm was the quietest stretch: 6.7 orders a day (9% of the day's orders), vs 23.8 a day at 8am–10am, the busiest.

insights.title: Pastries sell more before 11am
insights.recommendation: Have most pastries baked and out before 11am: 58% of pastries sell by then. Keep Chocolate Chip Cookie stocked after lunch: 30% of its sales come after 2pm.
insights.summary: 58% of pastries sell before 11am, when 54% of orders come in. Chocolate Chip Cookie is the afternoon pastry: 30% of it sells after 2pm.
